items.source: Returns whether an excerpt projection has been registered for the given type.
items.translation: 返回是否已为给定类型注册了摘录投影。

items.source: Creates a excerpt projection for the given source. If no excerpt projection is available, the object will be returned as is. If you completely wish to skip handling the object, check for the presence of an excerpt projection using hasExcerptProjection(Class).
items.translation: 为给定的源创建摘录投影。如果不可用任何摘录投影，则原样返回该对象。如果您完全希望跳过对该对象的处理，请使用 hasExcerptProjection(Class) 检查是否存在摘录投影。

items.source: Interface for a component that can provide excerpt projections.
items.translation: 提供摘要投影的组件接口。

items.source: Creates a excerpt projection for the given source.
